step1_analysis.circuit_type: Parasitic capacitance model of a cross-coupled inverter (latch)
step1_analysis.description: This circuit models the parasitic capacitances introduced by the distributed CMOS inverters onto the differential transmission line of a Rotary Traveling-Wave Oscillator (RTWO). It includes gate-source, drain-bulk, drain-gate, and interconnect capacitances that load the transmission line.

paper_reference.title: Rotary Traveling-Wave Oscillator Arrays: A New Clock Technology

C_diff.description: Equivalent differential capacitance between nodes A and B

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a parameterized value of 1pF per parasitic component for simulation purposes. C_diff = C_AB + (C_A_gnd * C_B_gnd)/(C_A_gnd + C_B_gnd). With 5 cross-capacitors (5pF) and 4 ground-referenced capacitors per node (4pF), C_diff = 5pF + (4pF || 4pF) = 7pF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The actual value depends heavily on the sizing of the distributed inverters in the RTWO. The paper reports 2pF for a specific segment, so the expected range is in the low picofarads.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the equivalent differential capacitance of the parasitic model using an AC current source.
